description: This file defines the internal implementation of the Orleans Runtime Management Grain, providing management operations for silos, grains, and strategies within an Orleans cluster.

classes.name: ManagementGrain
classes.description: Implementation of the Orleans management grain providing various cluster management functionalities.

methods.name: GetHosts
methods.description: Retrieves a dictionary of silo addresses with their statuses, optionally only for active silos.

methods.name: GetDetailedHosts
methods.description: Retrieves detailed membership entries for silos, optionally filtering only active ones.

methods.name: ForceGarbageCollection
methods.description: Triggers garbage collection on specified silos.

methods.name: ForceActivationCollection
methods.description: Triggers activation collection on specified silos, with an optional age limit parameter.

methods.name: ForceRuntimeStatisticsCollection
methods.description: Triggers collection of runtime statistics on specified silos.

methods.name: GetRuntimeStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves runtime statistics from specified silos.

methods.name: GetSimpleGrainStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves simple grain statistics from specified silos.

methods.name: GetDetailedGrainStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves detailed grain statistics filtered by types from specified silos.

methods.name: GetGrainActivationCount
methods.description: Counts the number of activations for a specific grain across silos.

methods.name: SetCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Sets the compatibility strategy cluster-wide or for a specific interface.

methods.name: SetSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Sets the version selection strategy cluster-wide or for a specific interface.

methods.name: GetTotalActivationCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of grain activations across the cluster.

methods.name: SendControlCommandToProvider
methods.description: Sends a control command to a grain provider.

methods.name: GetActivationAddress
methods.description: Gets the silo address where a given grain instance is activated.

methods.name: GetActiveGrains
methods.description: Retrieves the list of active grains of a specific type across silos.

methods.name: GetGrainCallFrequencies
methods.description: Retrieves the frequency of grain calls between silos.

methods.name: ResetGrainCallFrequencies
methods.description: Resets the recorded grain call frequencies.
